quality.review_scope: Independent scoped scientific quick audit accepted the complete locally matched main PDF pp.1–2 and SI pp.1–11 for the packaged CdSe precursor and TNM gel route, full Ag2Se exchange and drying, the separate partial-Ag wet-gel illustration, PbSe/CuSe analog branches, main Figures 1–3/Table 1 and SI Figures S1–S7. The main/SI concentration and gel-timing disagreements, unreported partial/analog doses, and Figure S4 contents conflict remain explicit. Earlier cited Peng, Aldana and Arachchige papers were not imported.
missing_fields: Exact Ag+ dose, exchange time and workup for Figure 1B partial exchange are not reported.
Pb(NO3)2 and Cu(NO3)2 concentrations and solution volumes are not restated for the analog routes.
The paper does not report quantitative PbSe/CuSe EDS ratios or pore metrics.
The exact TNM oxidative bridge topology, thiolate surface coverage and atomistic cation locations are not measured.
The 36° Ag2Se diffraction feature may include disorder or a secondary amorphous component; no unique assignment is made.
The full Ag2Se drying is said to follow CdSe SI conditions; distinct Ag2Se dryer settings are not restated.
conflicts: Main p.1 gives nominal Cd2+ concentration 0.025 M and AgNO3 0.15 M, a sixfold numerical ratio, while SI p.3 calls 0.15 M AgNO3 '5 times the nominal Cd2+ concentration'. Preserve both published statements; do not repair the ratio silently.
Main p.1 waits 12 h after adding Ag+ before methanol wash; SI p.3 says Ag2Se wet gel develops after 'a few hours'. These are distinct described endpoints and are both retained.
The text layer misrecognizes α-Ag2Se as R-Ag2Se. Original PDF page rendering visually confirms Greek α in main p.1–2.
Main Figure 2 insets are reference crystal diagrams; they are not measured atomic structures of the pictured aerogels.
SI contents p.1 calls Figure S4 porosimetry of CdSe and Ag2Se, but actual Figure S4 caption/plot on p.8 shows Ag2Se only; no CdSe S4 curve is assigned.
